title: Epiberberine alleviates cadmium-induced duodenal inflammation in Hu sheep by inhibiting HIF-1 signaling pathway.
authors: Zhang, Huimin; Yan, Shuo; Du, Ruilin; Ma, Zimeng; Xue, Yue; Zhao, Yulong; Yao, Wenna; Chen, Chen; Li, Xihe; Bao, Siqin; Song, Yongli
one_liner_zh: 该文研究小檗碱通过抑制HIF-1信号通路缓解镉诱导的十二指肠炎症，虽含分子对接但核心为动物实验与多组学，非蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA结合建模，与本课题关联微弱。
abstract: Environmental cadmium (Cd) exposure not only poses a significant threat to livestock health but also induces intestinal disorders in sheep. As a critical region for digestion and absorption, damage to the duodenum directly impairs systemic health. To elucidate the key mechanisms underlying Cd-induced duodenal injury and identify preventive and therapeutic strategies, this study utilized Cd-exposed Hu sheep as experimental models and applied multi-omics technologies, including non-targeted metabolomics, proteomics, and transcriptomics. The results showed that Cd exposure caused severe damage to the duodenum of Hu sheep, characterized by inflammatory cell infiltration and disruption of the intestinal barrier. Multi-omics analysis revealed that Cd exposure reduced levels of beneficial metabolites (such as vitamin K and riboflavin) while activating the HIF-1 signaling pathway. Through network pharmacology screening and molecular docking validation, epiberberine (EPI) was identified as a promising therapeutic candidate targeting the HIF-1alpha. Mouse fecal microbiota transplantation (FMT) experiments further confirmed that EPI can restore the intestinal barrier integrity, mitigate inflammatory responses, and effectively alleviate Cd-induced duodenal damage by inhibiting the HIF-1 signaling pathway, providing a novel approach for preventing and treating intestinal diseases under cadmium exposure.
abstract_zh: 环境镉（Cd）暴露不仅对牲畜健康构成重大威胁，还会诱发绵羊肠道疾病。十二指肠作为消化吸收的关键区域，其损伤直接影响全身健康。为阐明镉诱导十二指肠损伤的关键机制并寻找防治策略，本研究以镉暴露的湖羊为实验模型，应用非靶向代谢组学、蛋白质组学和转录组学等多组学技术。结果表明，镉暴露导致湖羊十二指肠严重损伤，表现为炎症细胞浸润和肠道屏障破坏。多组学分析显示，镉暴露降低了有益代谢物（如维生素K和核黄素）的水平，同时激活了HIF-1信号通路。通过网络药理学筛选和分子对接验证，表小檗碱（epiberberine, EPI）被确定为靶向HIF-1α的潜在治疗候选药物。小鼠粪菌移植（FMT）实验进一步证实，EPI可通过抑制HIF-1信号通路恢复肠道屏障完整性、减轻炎症反应，并有效缓解镉诱导的十二指肠损伤，为镉暴露下肠道疾病的预防和治疗提供了新途径。
